name: Kari Lake
current_role: Senior adviser to the U.S. Agency for Global Media (since March 2025); Trump's nominee for U.S. Ambassador to Jamaica (May 2026)
summary: Kari Lake was a Phoenix TV news anchor at KSAZ (Fox 10) from 1999 to 2021, then a Trump-endorsed Republican nominee who lost the 2022 Arizona governor's race to Katie Hobbs, refused to concede and lost a two-year court challenge, and lost the 2024 Senate race to Ruben Gallego. Trump picked her to lead Voice of America; as a USAGM adviser and, from July to November 2025, its acting CEO she drove mass layoffs, and in March 2026 a federal judge ruled her acting tenure unlawful and voided those actions. In May 2026 Trump nominated her ambassador to Jamaica.
